risk_note: RV2 (ledger). Daily check runner runDailyCheck per BR-FUND-19 (decisions 20, 31, 33, 34). Writes daily_balances for the check date in entry sign: set = every account x sub_account with entries up to D or snapshots before D (plus rows already present for D so stale rows are recomputed); opening = D-1 closing if present else the sum of entries before D; debit / credit = that day's totals; closing = opening + debit - credit; ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE so reruns overwrite; computed_at from the injected Clock. Writes take a transaction-level advisory lock first and read entries in later statements, so a whole-app run and a single-app rerun cannot overwrite a newer snapshot with stale reads (money round 1 S0). Then runs db/invariants/ledger/*.sql in file order, skipping files listed in superseded.json, each in its own read-only transaction after SET LOCAL couli.check_date; multi-statement files are refused; PG errors become DAILY_CHECK_FAILED keeping SQLSTATE in cause.code; malformed output fails the run. Differences are summed per account / global with pino alerts; checked_rows 0 is an empty-check alert, not a global difference. Withdrawal freeze, auto-settle switch and error tickets are suggestions only (TODO blocked on B2-04 / B2-05). Integer fen sums only.
